scope: Source protocol fixtures with the existing native/Android stubs; not gameplay or visual acceptance.

checks.name: Accepted Save emits busy feedback synchronously, before native preparation or F7
Repeated busy taps keep the same operation and create exactly one archive
Saved feedback follows real phone archive acknowledgement and exposes its ID
Readiness and active-purchase rejections expose errors immediately without saving
A rejected phone archive and failed storage sync never show Saved
Death at first feedback or native-write stage cannot publish a stale Saved state
Save waits for the native Rewards drawer close acknowledgement before F7
Missing animation frames stay bounded; an unclosed drawer fails within the original 15-second deadline
A broken display observer cannot invalidate an acknowledged save
